info.name: OpenText™ Core Application Security Web API Explorer ApiKeyManagement StaticScans API

params.name: releaseId
params.description: The release id

params.name: assessmentTypeId
params.description:
The assessment type id for the scan

Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/releases/{releaseId}/assessment-types

params.name: fragNo
params.description: -1 indicates the fragment of bytes has been sent. The value starts with 0 and increments by 1 for each fragment of bytes sent

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the bytes sent. 0 indicates the first bytes

params.name: entitlementId
params.description: The entitlement id to consume

params.name: entitlementFrequencyType
params.description: The entitlement frequency type

params.name: technologyStack
params.description:
The technology stack

Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=TechnologyTypes

params.name: languageLevel
params.description:
The language level

Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=LanguageLevels

params.name: isRemediationScan
params.description: Indicates of the scan is a remediation scan. Value defaults to false if not specified.

params.name: doSonatypeScan
params.description: Obsolete. Use doOpenSourceScan instead. This parameter may be removed in a future release. Value defaults to false if not specified.

params.name: excludeThirdPartyLibs
params.description: Indicates if third party libraries should be excluded. Value defaults to false if not specified.

params.name: scanPreferenceType
params.description: This parameter is depcrecated.

params.name: auditPreferenceType
params.description: The audit preference type

params.name: fallbackToActiveEntitlement
params.description: Use existing active entitlement if specified entitlement is expired. Value defaults to true if not specified.

params.name: isBundledAssessment
params.description: Indicates if the assessment is a bundled assessment. If not supplied legacy behavior will apply. Value defaults to null if not specified.

params.name: parentAssessmentTypeId
params.description: The parent assessment type id for the bundled assessment. If not supplied legacy behavior will apply

params.name: notes
params.description: The notes about the scan.

params.name: scanMethodType
params.description: The method of starting a scan

params.name: scanTool
params.description: The tool used for scanning

params.name: scanToolVersion
params.description: The version for the scan tool used for scanning

params.name: doOpenSourceScan
params.description: Indicates if an open source scan should be included. Value defaults to false if not specified.

params.name: doBinaryScan
params.description: Indicates that mixed mode scanning should be used. Value defaults to null if not specified.

params.name: includeFortifyAviator
params.description: Indicates whether SAST Aviator Addon Service is requested. Value defaults to null if not specified.
